# baffinbay_ip_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay IP List by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_ip_list" "office" {
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the IP list to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `last_updated_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `used_by` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--used_by))
